title: Ziplining and Climbing at The Adventure Park on Cape Cod
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Are you ready for the best climbing and zip line adventure Cape Cod has to offer? Get outside and into our aerial adventure park to experience our self-guided tree-to-tree climbing adventure. Perfect for families, friends, birthday parties and groups of all ages! Ideal for all adults and children 7+ at any fitness level, you'll go at your own pace for a fun, exciting, and self-guided adventure, the perfect combination of challenge and fun. You'll start with a safety briefing and practice session, then choose your own adventure among our 5 treetop trails. The experience is self-guided and focused on exploration and discovery. With roughly 60 tree top platforms connected by bridges, ladders, 7 zip lines and other crossings, our trails are color-coded like ski trails for all abilities and are designed for self-discovery. Our helpful staff are always at hand and available for questions and assistance.
